name: Asian Energy Services Ltd
tagline: Small/mid-cap oilfield-services provider (formerly Asian Oilfield Services) with decent returns (16.5% ROCE) but a rich ~40x P/E, declining promoter holding and stretched receivables (160 debtor days).
business_overview: Asian Energy Services Ltd (NSE/BSE: ASIANENE, formerly Asian Oilfield Services) operates in the Oil Equipment & Services sector, providing oilfield/drilling-related services to E&P operators. Entity confirmed via screener.in (ticker ASIANENE) and forum cross-check (legacy 'asian-oilfields' thread). Seeded 2026-09-13 via untrusted X triage (@rishithegreat41 + 2 more, medium conviction).
fundamentals_narrative: Returns are respectable but not exceptional (ROCE 16.5%, ROE 12.9%) for a ~40x trailing P/E - the market is pricing in continued growth from the global/India oilfield-services up-cycle rather than current profitability. Long-run revenue growth (10-year median ~46.7%) reflects the lumpy, project/tender-driven nature of oilfield services rather than a smooth compounding trend. Two caution flags surfaced this pass: promoter holding fell by ~4.6 percentage points in the latest quarter, and debtor days are high (~160), suggesting working-capital strain typical of tender-based E&P service contracts. Neither rises to a red-flag tier (no negative net worth, no SEBI action, no auditor resignation) but both temper conviction.
